signals.origin: Nathan Direct 2026-09-24 11:07 EDT; expanded 2026-09-24 with Nathan On requirement
signals.intent: Establish or reconcile a vetted point-of-use Tools Library available selectively to any workflow instance, including a curated Nathan-direct interpretive companion.
signals.evidence: Nathan is now formalizing reusable epistemology, logic, mathematics, geometry, bridge, and domain modules; multiple older toolboxes/toolkits and vetted computational/formal tools already exist across the project and should be mined rather than dumped wholesale. Nathan also requires a curated 'Nathan On' lane drawn from direct explanations, corrections, and methodological passages, selected for current workflow relevance rather than bulk quotation.
signals.suggested_action: Check whether an equivalent Tools Library already exists. If not, create one. Organize it for smart point-of-use access to common tool packs rather than as a document dump; e.g. LogicTools; MathTools with nested WorldtubePack and HighEnergyPack (including Nuclear and CondensedMatter where appropriate); GeometryTools with SAT and Standard branches; plus other domain packs as the inventory warrants. Any tool already built and vetted should be placed there or linked from there. Older toolboxes/toolkits are source mines only: selectively extract, review, normalize, namespace, and incorporate useful tools. Add a 'Nathan On' surface/package containing carefully selected Nathan-direct passages that explain, constrain, motivate, correct, or complement the tools and packs. Prefer passages that sit naturally beside relevant tools, while also allowing a small set of cross-cutting Nathan-direct principles that do not map cleanly to one tool. Nathan On is not a generic quote archive: every inclusion should have provenance, scope, current-validity/status, relevance tags, and links to the tools/packs it clarifies; contradictory or superseded passages should be marked or excluded according to current authority rules. Keep provenance, version/status, dependencies, intended use, and validation state visible so workflow instances can load only the pack and Nathan-direct context they need.
signals.exit: A discoverable Tools Library or reconciled equivalent exists, with a compact index/manifest, point-of-use pack structure, a curated Nathan On lane, and an intake path for vetted tools and selected Nathan-direct context; legacy toolbox/toolkit and Nathan-direct collections remain source mines rather than bulk-ingested dumps.
